extensions.documentationMethod: Source-based record of the Klankgat direction chosen by Julian from six moodboards. This file is descriptive metadata, not an active workflow.

display.purpose: Hero and section headings, wordmark, quote.

body.purpose: Reading text, navigation, labels and controls.

label.purpose: Eyebrows above headings and lesson rows.

shadows.name: floating-action
shadows.purpose: Separates the floating mobile action from the page.

motion.name: strings
motion.purpose: Six strings strummed on arrival and plucked by the pointer.

motion.name: hero-arrival
motion.purpose: Copy rises in sequence; the soundhole turns into place.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Sections rise into view once when scrolled to.

motion.name: interaction
motion.purpose: Buttons, arrows, video thumbnails and lesson rows.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All of the above is disabled for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

inquiryFormStatus.privacy: Only an activated opaque endpoint is configured. The receiving address remains private and absent from public source, HTML, documentation and URLs.
inquiryFormStatus.validation: Verification and production inbox receipt are separate from this design record.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Ink text on an orange pill, 60px minimum height. Lifts on hover and its arrow slides.

components.name: Soundhole photo
components.description: Round photo inside an orange disc with two fine rings and a slowly turning dotted ring.

components.name: Six strings
components.description: Full-width SVG lines, 4px to 1px, that ring when strummed or plucked.

components.name: Video tile
components.description: 16:9 thumbnail with an orange play disc; opens a dialog sized to the video.

components.name: Form card
components.description: White card with 28px corners holding the booking or lesson form.

components.name: Lesson row
components.description: Full-width row with string-weight dividers and a circular arrow that turns orange on hover.

narrative.overview: A white page, one orange from the top of Hamlet's guitar, his photo always round inside a rosette, and six strings that ring when the page opens. The homepage sells an evening of live flamenco guitar; the lesson page sells the free first lesson.
keyCharacteristics: Unbounded headings and wordmark with the retained six-string H.
Onest for everything else; both faces cover Cyrillic.
One accent colour, used as a background for ink text.
Photos are round or pill-shaped; buttons are pills.

rules.name: Colour hierarchy
rules.body: Paper for the page, mist for alternate sections, ink for text and the closing band, orange only for invitations and the soundhole.

rules.name: Orange is a background
rules.body: Orange text on white is too faint; use ink on orange, or deep orange where coloured text is needed.

rules.name: Motion is optional
rules.body: Every animation sits behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference and nothing is hidden waiting for it.

dos: Preserve the approved lesson headline and the free introductory lesson.
Send each page's actions to that page's own form.
Keep the YouTube video behind a click.
Keep fonts Cyrillic-capable for the Russian version.
donts: Do not add prices, show dates, reviews or qualifications that are not confirmed.
Do not use the poster's lettering as site copy.
Do not add a show agenda or FAQ without Julian asking for it.
